items.prompt: How do FIX ExecType and OrdStatus differ?

options.text: Event reason versus reported state with precedence
options.why: One status label need not reveal all quantity/request dimensions.

options.text: Both are always a filled quantity in cents
options.why: They are code fields, not cents.

options.text: Both prove a cancellation was successful whenever pending
options.why: Pending cancel explicitly does not mean canceled.

options.text: OrdStatus always equals the most recent ExecType even when states overlap
options.why: Reported status follows precedence among simultaneous states; the event reason and current status are distinct fields.

items.explanation: Do not confuse the reason for a report with all underlying state dimensions.
